items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject all three proposed change requests. Financial claims are not supportable: Amazon reports only $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; the commission is unattributed. AI spend is $916.9145 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 5,009 calls, including 228 errors. Subtracting these figures would be misleading because the periods do not match, revenue is not site-attributed, and infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment, commitment, and budget costs are absent. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, and forecasts are therefore unknown. SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating indicators, not financial outcomes. Continue only the existing matching-period reconciliation work item.

CFO disposition: do not dispatch or requeue the proposed dumbsluts.com, elevatorfriends.com, or findyourlostpets.com previews. They lack validated cost-to-learn thresholds and their analytics or revenue attribution is unavailable or incomplete. Preserve them as deferred previews; no financial lift or payback claim is supported.

Continue the existing revenue and attribution reconciliation only. Preserve the $4.92 Amazon commission for 2026-09-21 as aggregate and unattributed. Do not treat missing site revenue, costs, budgets, commitments, or infrastructure spend as zero.
